event.summary: Removing vendor DOM disposables does not leave grid gesture listeners installed
event.detail: Reviewed commit: f560058da19e02716e6f943883a9508b447aff4e. TLDR: considered whether removing the old terminal's disposable DOM/event utilities leaves mouse drags or animation work alive after closing a terminal. Source refutation: the deleted portions 01085-018/019 contain vendor-local event listeners, animation scheduling, focus and pointer-monitor helpers; the replacement owns its own lifecycle. At the reviewed revision, crates/farhelm-ui/assets/grid-terminal.js:1747-1759 removes document mousemove/mouseup handlers in stopGesture, and :2109-2140 dispose cancels painting, pixel-ratio and visibility listeners, history-drain work, gesture listeners, slider listeners and fade timers, clears callbacks and removes its element. The ordering explicitly releases the slider before clearing its newly armed fade timer. Contract: SPEC_impl.md, Terminal widget: the grid island / The grid client, assigns all terminal DOM/input/selection to the grid and connection lifetime to terminal.js. Suggested bucket: other if established; confidence: confirmed source refutation, no execution. proposed_drop: refuted by the replacement's own disposal paths, not by specification acceptance. possible_cover: none. Could-be-highest: false; the considered consequence was stale listeners or retained DOM work, with no established security or loss-of-work route. Caveat: this record addresses removal of the assigned vendor helpers, not a whole-grid lifecycle audit.

event.summary: Vendor touch helper removal does not remove a terminal-host input route
event.detail: Reviewed commit: f560058da19e02716e6f943883a9508b447aff4e. TLDR: considered whether deletion of bundled touch/inertia helpers removes scrolling from a still-used terminal route. The original suspected consequence was unavailable touch scrolling for a touch-only viewer. Source checks settle the deletion-specific premise: the parent terminal.js:4650-4667 already sends every known terminal-host terminal directly to createGridSurface, building no xterm surface; parent SPEC_impl.md:1896-1918 explicitly describes that same route ('A new terminal mounts the grid component directly: nothing of xterm.js is built, measured, waited for or published as a test hook for it'). Parent grid-terminal.js:1830-1870 already uses the same mouse/wheel path. Removing the vendor helpers therefore cannot remove touch handling from the grid route. The reviewed contract SPEC.md:2999-3017 retires old terminals, while SPEC_impl.md:1504-1514 assigns every served terminal to the grid. No continuing old-terminal route requiring these helpers is established by this assignment. Suggested bucket: high for the originally suspected unavailable input; confidence: confirmed source refutation of a newly removed grid dependency, no execution. proposed_drop: source refutation, with the deletion-review boundary: the brief says 'For deletions, assess the implications of removal and the replacement's contracts; do not search retired implementation for independent defects unrelated to removal.' possible_cover: none. Could-be-highest: false; no security or loss-of-work consequence was proposed. Caveat: this is not a finding that touch interaction is complete, nor a claim of explicit specification acceptance for missing touch support; any broader pre-existing grid touch audit belongs to that source group's scope. Lead settled as candidate; no missing source premise retained.
